records.issue_text: Tautological find makes selectedCalendar undefined in Google update/delete: in packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts (~lines 253-256 and ~314-317), when externalCalendarId is falsy the fallback searches destinationCalendar for a cal whose externalId equals that falsy value, never matching, so selectedCalendar is undefined and the Google API is called with calendarId: undefined; updates/deletes for bookings without a stored externalCalendarId will fail
records.rationale: The diff changes updateEvent/deleteEvent fallbacks to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`, which is only evaluated when externalCalendarId is falsy; searching for a calendar whose externalId equals a falsy value can never match (destinationCalendar entries have real externalIds), so selectedCalendar/calendarId becomes undefined where the old code returned `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`. This is a tautological, dead fallback introduced by this diff, plausibly breaking updates/deletes for bookings without a stored externalCalenda
